title: Discount upper quantity bound (proposed demo demand)
practical_value: Proposed field-role demand in 1 demos. Preserve source value; external reference matching requires evidence.
licence_notes: Candidate metadata is unreconciled. Per-input data/model/meaning licences remain in demand-plan.json and recordset records; Employees-derived evidence retains CC-BY-SA-3.0. No blanket CC0 or canonical new meaning licence is asserted.
reason:
Related concepts, entity keys/names/attributes and physical roles remain separately qualified in assertions. Coverage means inspected hypothesis presence, not accepted semantic equivalence or external match rate.

Phase 2 UNRESOLVED: Quantity kind, unit identifier, measured value, ordinal rating and packaging are distinct. Conversion requires both reviewed units and compatible quantity kinds, including scale/offset and product quantity for packaging. BOX is not a mass unit; weight unit code is not weight; film rating is not physical measurement. Retain datum, unit, interval and quality metadata. Definition gap: the candidate combines source roles or lacks a sufficiently bounded reusable definition and binding domain. Retain the candidate; do not infer absence from literal query results. Examined 1 physical field-role hypotheses for this group; their individual dispositions govern implementation.
